what: Default EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=1 in eval_test_runner.sh fails legitimate golden cells: host-side refusal tests allocate nothing (peak_total=0 forced to L1ProfilingError) and disable_and_clear_program_cache() for the whole test body makes trace-capture cases fail (eager warm-up never cached). 10/20 false failures; needed a second run with EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=0 to prove the op clean.
suggest: Skip L1 capture (or accept peak 0) for tests that dispatch no op, and restrict cache-disable to the graded call window (op_window) so trace warm-ups are cached; mention EVAL_CAPTURE_L1=0 in the verifier prompt until fixed.
